{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox college sports team season | year = 2022–23 | team = Missouri Tigers | sport= Basketball | image = Mizzou Athletics wordmark.svg | image_size = 250 | conference = Southeastern Conference | short_conf = SEC | CoachRank = | APRank = 23 | record = 25–10 | conf_record = 11–7 | head_coach = [[Dennis Gates]] | hc_year = 1st | assoc_coach = [[Charlton Young]] (1st season) | asst_coach1 = [[Dickey Nutt]] (1st season) | asst_coach2 = Kyle Smithpeters (1st season) | stadium = [[Mizzou Arena]] | champion = | tourney = [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2022–23 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Missouri]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]] and is led by first-year head coach [[Dennis Gates]]. The team plays its home games at [[Mizzou Arena]] in [[Columbia, Missouri]] as an eleventh-year members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 23–8, 11-7 in SEC play to finish in 4th place. They defeated [[2022–23 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the first round of the [[2023 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2022–23 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the second round. Tigers received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they were awarded a No. 7 seed in the South Region. They defeated [[2022–23 Utah State Aggies men's basketball team|Utah State]] in the first round before suffering an upset defeat by 15th-seeded [[2022–23 Princeton Tigers men's basketball team|Princeton]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2021-22 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team|Tigers]] finished the season 12–21, 5–13 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in 12th place. They defeated [[2021–22 Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball team|Ole Miss]] in the first round of the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 LSU Tigers men's basketball team|LSU]] in the second round. Following the season, the school fired head coach [[Cuonzo Martin]]. {{Cite web |date=2022-03-11 |title=Cuonzo Martin out at Missouri after five season following 12-21 season for Tigers |url= https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/cuonzo-martin-out-at-missouri-after-five-seasons-following-12-21-season-for-tigers/ |access-date=April 1, 2022 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}} On March 22, 2022, the school named [[Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball|Cleveland State]] head coach Dennis Gates the new head coach of the Tigers.{{Cite web |date=2022-03-22 |title=Mizzou hires Cleveland State’s Dennis Gates as men’s basketball coach |url=https://www.kshb.com/sports/college-sports/mu/mizzou-hires-cleveland-states-dennis-gates-as-mens-basketball-coach |access-date=2022-08-16 |website=KSHB |language=en}} == Offseason == ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
